title: Server-internal scan commit history context v1
$comment: Server-internal only; never accepted by public RPC. Writer selects students or inventory bucket. Immutable runtime adapter validates exact integer types, valid UTF-8 byte bounds, canonical identity uniqueness and applied/excluded disjointness. Flat provenance including excluded_keys/retry_of joins the new request fingerprint; existing nested current-history-v1 event stays unchanged. JSON Schema alone cannot enforce these semantic constraints. Filename/id carry v1; no version property.

candidate_revision.$comment: Matches existing ScanHistoryContext; current scanner public commit still requires >=1.

inventory_scan_profile.$comment: Required, nullable, raw session.target value; never catalog entry.profile_id. Preserve null, whitespace, case and unknown text.

applied_keys.$comment: Writer students maps keys to student_id; writer inventory canonicalizes known resource aliases before unique/disjoint checks. No mixed bucket, raw kind inference or fabricated slot identity. Nonempty approved scope only; array order is preserved in the fingerprint.

excluded_keys.$comment: Identified excluded entries only; unknown slot is not a key. Internal provenance/fingerprint only, not a new persisted event field or applied scope.

retry_of.$comment: Nullable opaque provenance ID, not retry permission or a new application request. Replay keeps the original value, including null; changing it under the same idempotency key conflicts. Not stored as an event field.

rawText.$comment: Runtime must enforce 1..1024 UTF-8 bytes without enum/trim/case conversion. maxLength counts Unicode characters, not bytes. Invalid UTF-8 text must be rejected.

identity.$comment: Runtime enforces valid UTF-8 1..1024 bytes for new flat identities. This does not tighten old nested context, stored current-history event or legacy cache validators.
